name: Kommuri Pratap Reddy Institute of Technology (KPRIT)
description: KPRIT is situated in Ghatkesar, Hyderabad. Affiliated with JNTUH and accredited by NAAC with A+ grade. Home to active departments in CSE, AI & Data Science, ECE, Mechanical, and Civil Engineering.
hostelLifeNotes: Over 65% of students commute from Uppal, Secunderabad, Dilsukhnagar, and ECIL via college buses (45–75 mins commute). Department labs feature standard power strips for heavier gaming/workstation rigs during CAD & simulation lab sessions.
